sections.heading: How Immify works

2. Discover providers: browse relevant services and review the information available on each listing.
3. Compare and enquire: ask questions, request a quote or book a consultation where offered.

sections.heading: Trust and transparency

/about.title: About Immify | Connecting Aspirants with Global Service Providers
/about.description: Learn how Immify helps people exploring immigration, visas, study abroad, careers and relocation discover services and connect with providers.
/about.heading: A Better Way to Discover Support for Your Global Journey
/about.intro:
Immify is a global immigration and mobility services platform designed to connect immigration aspirants with relevant service providers. Whether someone is exploring a visa, permanent residency, overseas education, international work or relocation, Immify brings service discovery and enquiry options together in one place.

Our aim is to make the early stages of planning easier: help people understand the types of support available, discover providers by category and destination, and ask clearer questions before making a decision.

For service providers, Immify offers a marketplace presence to describe services and connect with people looking for help. The platform experience should be built around clear information, transparent listings and responsible communication.

sections.heading: Our principles
items: Clarity: explain service scope and next steps in plain language.
Choice: help users explore relevant options before contacting a provider.
Transparency: distinguish listing information from verified credentials and official decisions.
Responsibility: encourage users to confirm fees, terms and qualifications before engaging.
Global perspective: support a range of immigration, education, career and relocation needs.

/faq.title: Immify FAQs | Services, Providers, Enquiries & Listings
/faq.description: Find answers about using Immify to discover immigration services, contact providers, check eligibility and list services as a provider.
/faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

sections.heading: What is Immify?
items: Immify is a platform for discovering immigration, visa, study abroad, career, relocation and related services, and connecting with service providers.

sections.heading: Does Immify issue visas or decide eligibility?
items: No. Visa and immigration decisions are made by the relevant government authorities. Immify helps users discover services and providers; an online screening tool is not an official decision.

sections.heading: How do I find a provider?
items: Browse a service category, search by destination or keyword, review available listing information and contact a provider through the options shown.

sections.heading: How can I compare providers?
items: Review service scope, destination expertise, qualifications or authorisation where required, written fees, contract terms and communication arrangements. Verify important details independently.

sections.heading: Can I get a free eligibility check?
items: If the eligibility tool is available, it can provide an initial indication based on submitted details. It is not a guarantee of eligibility or approval.

sections.heading: How do I become a provider?
items: Register a business account, complete your profile, add service listings and submit requested verification details. Review the current plan and listing terms.

sections.heading: Does Immify guarantee a job or visa?
items: No. Employment, visa decisions, admission and immigration outcomes depend on employers, institutions, service providers and relevant authorities.

sections.heading: Are providers verified?
items: Check the information shown on each listing and independently confirm professional authorisation, qualifications and destination expertise. A marketplace listing alone does not establish that a provider is licensed or verified.

sections.heading: How are provider fees charged?
items: Provider plans and included features are shown on the Pricing page. Individual service fees are set out in the listing or quoted by the provider. Confirm taxes, renewal and cancellation terms before paying.

sections.heading: What should I include in an enquiry?
items: Share your goal, destination and the information needed to describe your request. Confirm who will receive your details and how documents will be handled before sharing sensitive information.

sections.heading: How do I report a suspicious listing?
items: Use the Contact page to send an enquiry with the listing link, provider name and a description of your concern. Avoid including passwords, payment card details or unnecessary identity documents.
